summary: a supervisor case plants its child verdict through one helper that stamps the writing tick, so no stub can leave the stamp off

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: every site in tests/loopSupervisor.test.ts that plants a child verdict for the supervisor to read goes through one helper that stamps the writing child's identity from its request, the site comments that hand-held that stamp shrink to a pointer at the helper, and the suite is green
notes: Operator's ruling (inbox, 2026-10-23): `tickId` is the writer's stamp, not a dispatcher fact. `readTickVerdict` (`src/tickVerdict.ts`) answers undefined when the stamp is not the one asked for, so `src/loopSupervisor.ts` takes its no-verdict arm over a stub that forgot — held today by prose at each site. `verdictFixture` stays exported: a generated fixture in `tests/subprocessHelper.test.ts` names it. The whole diff is test files, so no `tests[]` line is judgeable.
